newsitem.title: BARBADOS: CRICKET-SAMUELS RECALLED TO WEST INDIES' SIDE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SAMUELS RECALLED TO WEST INDIES' SIDE.

text.p: Jamaican opener Robert Samuels has been recalled to the West Indies' squad for the second and final test against Sri Lanka in Kingstown, St Vincent, on Friday.

Left-hander Samuels. overlooked for the recent series against India, replaces the injured Shivnarine Chanderpaul, who is being treated for muscle spasms in his neck after an injury during a domestic match.
West Indies won the first test in Antigua on Sunday by six wickets within three days.

West Indies - Courtney Walsh (captain), Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Brian Lara, Robert Samuels, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Floyd Reifer, Courtney Browne, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Franklyn Rose, Mervyn Dillon.
